NONE: › from or referring to the period of time between around 208 and 146 million years ago, in which the first birds appeared and the single piece of land broke up into separate continents
侏羅紀的（2.08億年前至1.46億年前之間的地質年代。該時期出現了最早的鳥類，一大片陸地斷裂成幾個大陸。）
› relating to the law
法律的；司法的
› the authority of a court or official organization to make decisions and judgments
司法權；管轄權；審判權

example: The court has no jurisdiction in/over cases of this kind.
該法庭無權審判此類案件。
School admissions are not under/within our jurisdiction.

NONE: › the study of law and the principles on which law is based
法學；法律學
› an expert in law, especially a judge
法學家；法律專家；（尤指）法官
› a member of a jury
陪審員，陪審團成員
B2 a group of people who have been chosen to listen to all the facts in a trial in a law court and to decide if a person is guilty or not guilty, or if a claim has been proved
陪審團
C1 a group of people chosen to decide the winner of a competition
（競賽的）裁判團，評審委員會

example: The jury has/have been unable to return a verdict (= reach a decision).
Police officers aren't usually allowed to be/sit/serve on a jury.
警察通常不准當陪審團成員。

NONE: › the place in a court where the jury sits
陪審（團）席
› a period of time when a person is a member of a jury
擔任陪審員期間

example: I'm on/doing jury service next week.
